doan_van.ten: Truyện — Bữa ăn ở nhà hàng
doan_van.noi_dung: Last Sunday, Minh and his friend Ben went to a new restaurant for lunch. They sat near the window and looked at the menu carefully. Minh does not eat meat, so he wanted a vegetarian meal with fresh vegetables and rice. Ben chose a hot dish with chicken and noodles. The waiter asked them about their drinks and they ordered two cold juices. However, when the food arrived, the waiter gave Minh a plate of spicy beef. Minh quickly told the waiter about his diet and explained that he does not eat meat. The waiter apologised for the mistake and brought a new dish of warm fried rice with delicious vegetables. It was not too salty and tasted wonderful. They enjoyed their food together and had a lovely time. At the end, Ben asked for the bill, and they paid for their meal happily.

The waiter points out that the establishment is strictly vegetarian because they serve only fresh vegetables and noodles. The waiter tells him to leave because he disturbs other customers. The bear leaves hungry and empty handed. Greed often leaves one with nothing.

- **dessert** /dɪˈzɜːt/ (tráng miệng, trọng âm sau) vs **desert** /ˈdezət/ (sa mạc, trọng âm trước).
- **rice** /raɪs/ vs **lice** /laɪs/ (chấy) — người Việt hay nhầm /r/ và /l/. Âm /r/ lưỡi cuộn, không chạm vòm miệng.
luu_y:
**① Danh từ đếm được vs không đếm được**

|                |Đếm được                |Không đếm được                                |
|----------------|------------------------|----------------------------------------------|
|Ví dụ           |apple, egg, bottle, dish|rice, water, meat, sugar, bread, money, coffee|
|Số nhiều        |có (apples)             |**không** (❌ rices, ❌ waters)                 |
|a/an            |có                      |không                                         |
|many / much     |**many**                |**much**                                      |
|a few / a little|**a few**               |**a little**                                  |


> ❌ many money → ✅ **much** money
> ❌ a few water → ✅ **a little** water

**② Đếm chất không đếm được bằng “đơn vị chứa”:**
a **bottle of** water · a **cup of** coffee · a **bowl of** rice · a **slice of** bread · a **piece of** cake · two **kilos of** meat

**③ “I’d like” lịch sự hơn “I want” rất nhiều.** Trong nhà hàng, nói “I want beef” nghe cộc lốc như ra lệnh. Luôn dùng **I’d like** hoặc **Can I have**.

**④ Một số từ vừa đếm được vừa không, đổi nghĩa:**

- coffee (cà phê nói chung) vs **a coffee** (một cốc cà phê)
- chicken (thịt gà) vs **a chicken** (một con gà)

> Nói *I ate a chicken* = “tôi ăn nguyên một con gà”.

**⑤ food (thức ăn, không đếm được) vs dish (món ăn, đếm được).**
❌ My favourite food are noodles. → ✅ My favourite **dish is** noodles.
meo:
- **many/much:** “**M**any đi với **M**ột-hai-ba (đếm được)”. much đi với thứ đổ ra được (nước, đường, tiền).
- Nhớ danh từ không đếm được: hỏi “**cắt đôi có còn là nó không?**” — cắt đôi cốc nước vẫn là nước (không đếm được), cắt đôi quả táo thì không còn là quả táo (đếm được).
- **dessert có 2 chữ s** vì ai cũng muốn **s**econd **s**erving (phần thứ hai).

bai_tap.ten: many / much / a few / a little

The waiter gives him the paper and Nam leaves the stall satisfied.

mini_story.ten: Ngụ ngôn - Chú gấu tham ăn và nhà hàng chay
mini_story.truyen: A greedy bear enters a restaurant and demands the most expensive beef dish on the menu. The waiter points out that the establishment is strictly vegetarian because they serve only fresh vegetables and noodles. The bear refuses to listen and shouts that he wants pork or chicken for his meal instead. He ignores the server when asked if he is ready to order anything else. The waiter tells him to leave because he disturbs other customers. The bear leaves hungry and empty handed. Greed often leaves one with nothing.
